templates.name: 标准单人
templates.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, safe, 1girl, solo, long hair, brown eyes, light smile, looking at viewer, upper body, school uniform, classroom, soft lighting
templates.negative: worst quality, low quality, blurry, jpeg artifacts, bad hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, overexposed, blown out highlights, bloom, text, watermark, signature, lettering, score_1, score_2, score_3
templates.note: 最稳的入门模板：质量前缀 + 人数 + 景别 + 场景 + 光线；按「质量/安全→人数→角色→@画师→普通标签」追加，总数不超过约 40 个

templates.name: 白底全身立绘
templates.negative: worst quality, low quality, blurry, jpeg artifacts, bad hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, overexposed, blown out highlights, bloom, text, watermark, signature, lettering, score_1, score_2, score_3
templates.note: 实测 1080x2400 长条画布会触发立绘模式（1080 非 64 倍数也能出干净白底）；构图由画师 tag 自带，prompt 极简即可

templates.name: 双人横构图
templates.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, safe, 2girls, cowboy shot, side view, park, sunset, BREAK 1girl, long black hair, blue eyes, white dress, hugging, closed eyes, BREAK 1girl, short blonde hair, red eyes, school uniform, hugging, smile
templates.negative: worst quality, low quality, blurry, jpeg artifacts, bad hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, overexposed, blown out highlights, bloom, text, watermark, signature, lettering, score_1, score_2, score_3, fused bodies, bad anatomy, multiple views
templates.note: 多人必须 BREAK 分块 + 明确动作 + 横构图；避免两张正面大脸，side view + closed eyes 成功率最高

templates.name: 画师风格复刻 @hiten
templates.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, safe, 1girl, solo, (@hiten \(hitenkei\):1.5), portrait, looking at viewer, soft diffused lighting, shallow depth of field, white dress, flower field
templates.negative: worst quality, low quality, blurry, jpeg artifacts, bad hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, overexposed, blown out highlights, bloom, text, watermark, signature, lettering, score_1, score_2, score_3
templates.note: 画师 tag 权重给 1.3-1.6；任何 LoRA 都会压制画师 tag，复刻风格时把 LoRA 静音

templates.name: 轻小说插画
templates.prompt: safe, 1girl, solo, portrait, light novel illustration, soft diffused lighting, shallow depth of field, looking at viewer, white dress, flower field
templates.negative: worst quality, low quality, blurry, jpeg artifacts, bad hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, overexposed, blown out highlights, bloom, text, watermark, signature, lettering
templates.note: aesthetic 不要写 masterpiece/best quality（写了会油腻），负向不要 score_*；柔光 + 浅景深是轻小说插画感的关键

templates.name: 纯风景无人物
templates.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, safe, no humans, landscape, mountains, lake, forest, blue sky, clouds, sunlight, reflection
templates.negative: worst quality, low quality, blurry, jpeg artifacts, bad hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, overexposed, blown out highlights, bloom, text, watermark, signature, lettering, score_1, score_2, score_3
templates.note: 纯风景必须写 no humans；用具体场所和光线标签，不要写 beautiful / atmospheric 这类空词

templates.name: 角色复刻：千反田爱瑠
templates.prompt: safe, 1girl, solo, chitanda eru, hyouka, @nishiya futoshi, kyoto animation, year 2012, anime screenshot, official art, black hair, long hair, blunt bangs, purple eyes, kamiyama high school uniform, white shirt, sailor collar, red neckerchief, classic literature club room, bookshelves, old wooden desk, warm afternoon light, leaning forward, hands on desk, curious expression, sparkling eyes, looking at viewer, medium shot
templates.negative: worst quality, low quality, blurry, jpeg artifacts, bad hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, overexposed, blown out highlights, bloom, text, watermark, signature, lettering
templates.note: 训练集内的角色只需「角色 + 作品 + 画师/媒介」标签，不要重复描述外貌；加标志性场景/道具更像（千反田 = 古典部活动室 + 好奇前倾）

templates.name: 夜景霓虹
templates.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, safe, 1girl, solo, city, street, neon lights, night, rain, from behind, looking back, upper body, jacket
templates.negative: worst quality, low quality, blurry, jpeg artifacts, bad hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, overexposed, blown out highlights, bloom, text, watermark, signature, lettering, score_1, score_2, score_3
templates.note: 霓虹用具体光源标签（neon lights + night）而不是抽象氛围词；from behind + looking back 的回头背影最容易出氛围

templates.name: 日常教室

templates.negative: worst quality, low quality, blurry, jpeg artifacts, bad hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, overexposed, blown out highlights, bloom, text, watermark, signature, lettering, score_1, score_2, score_3
templates.note: 日常场景用具体场所（classroom）+ 窗光；坐姿 + 课桌能稳住肢体
